notes.title: Look, I'm on Steam!
notes.content:
Well, this is kind of a big deal, yeah? I finally have a Steam page for this game! As a kid, I never even thought I'd be doing this, making a game that'll get released and share a platform with some of the biggest games of all time, to a userbase of hundreds of millions.

This is how I'll primarily be sharing big news about the game, as well as any other announcements that I see relevant.

First thing's first, I'll be participating in Steam's Next Fest in October! I'll be sure to have some sort of demo ready for the event. How much content it'll have is still up in the air, it just depends on how much content has been made. I'm hoping to at least have around 30 minutes to 1 hour of playable content for the demo.

Second thing's second, that was my only announcement. Wow!

Also, just a big thanks to everyone who's been wishlisting the game. Your support is very appreciated!

- Gem
